mapper.update: UPDATE MB_TOPIC SET ENABLED = #{enabled}, MAX_LEN = #{maxLen}, AI = #{ai}, PROMPT = #{prompt}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TOPIC_NO = #{topicNo}
mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_NO AS userNo, U.ID AS id, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS profileUrl, STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', F.CREATED_AT) AS followDate FROM MB_TOPIC_FOLLOW F INNER JOIN MB_USER U ON U.USER_NO = F.USER_NO WHERE F.TOPIC_NO = #{topicNo} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, U.USER_NO DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MB_TOPIC WHERE 1=1 AND ENABLED = 0 AND UPDATE_DATE < DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '-' || ${day} || ' days')
